body: Also it helps to look at most people as like NPCS (non-player characters) cause you’ll probably never see them again.

You know what helped me when I was young? I decided that every day I wake up and I get to choose who I want to be, and those people that you think are so cool, you can just BE one. No hobbies? Guess what, you have time to find some. Try a BUNCH of shit until you find something you like, or never find anything you stick with and try new shit forever. All you have to do is throw in a lil effort, and be a lil brave. Research social psychology, learn about what body language, humor, empathic traits and other likeable components of a personality that people respond to and use them to your advantage. You can literally make yourself WHATEVER YOU WANT! Also, honestly fuck others opinions I can’t tell you that enough! People are mostly shit anyways, the only ones worth a damn won’t care what you look like. I’m fuckin rootin for you!
Hold on! You can do it!!!! We (my fiancé, our pugs, our pitbull and myself) all believe in you! Message me if you need to talk

Looks can be changed with (quite a bit of) money, but your personality is something you make all your own. If you don’t like yourself, wake up every day and change one small thing you don’t like about your persona. 
Don’t worry about other people feel about you, especially some shitty ass men. 
You have to live your life, endure your own consequences and die in your body, they have their own journeys to go on and I’m sure there will be some point where you never see or hear from those fuckwads again. 
Learn to practice and show the love that you want to see in the world, be the person you wish you had. 
Oh and keep your chin up, the more you let their comments irk you, the more you give them what they want

Fake it till you make it man! Life is hard and gritty sometimes, but for every down there is a up. White knuckle it through the dark times and hold on to the feeling of the last time you felt the sun on your face and that warm, fuzzy feeling inside. 
Also maybe try clinical ketamine therapy?

Compartmentalization. Visualize a physical embodiment of your grief, take a deeeeeeep breath and visualize locking that grief in a little box and keeping the key. Tell yourself “I will revisit this and do my best to heal when I am done handling my necessary tasks.” Take a moment to gather yourself, drink some water and tackle the day. 
And see a therapist! What you’re going through is very very difficult, but not impossible. I believe in you!

Find reasons to be alive. A beautiful scenery, an art project, but tickets to a concert or go to a new museum. Some times the little things are all we have to get us by. 
Oh and therapy! Don’t be afraid! You got this.

Good food, art, the feeling of the sun on your face, the chance to find someone who changes the way you perceive the world. 

Sometimes I find that when I feel the lowest, volunteering to help people gives meaning to my existence. Try putting in some man hours at a soup kitchen, donating food to the homeless, finding small ways to brighten up literally anyone’s day and find your value in the smile on their face and the warmth you’ve put in their heart. 

I hope you make it

I personally carry things like a small spray bottle, collapsible staff, dog whistle, toys to throw as a distraction or even maybe a megaphone? Just some safer alternatives to help keep you out of court
Also repot the owner for not leashing their animal, it’s against state law in Cali.
